notes: stage 3 run-up of mg90-d on dev-v006-2A-D, horn free, DPS-150 over the feed diode, experiment image: runup-open-1, runup-close-1, runup-open-6 and runup-close-6, three cycles each of a 5 V 100 % spin from rest at the near guard and a 500 ms coast with the bridge open, both directions, at the open and the close of sittings 1 and 6; the runway cut the 200 ms spin to 52 ms (1031 to 1040 driven rows). Current through stage 1 current-scale over each sweep's torque-off zero with the in-drive offset out, the crest sample, which at 100 % is the period mean; volts through terminal-chain; rail and board NTC from the manifest probe before each sweep. R the resistance result's r_term_ohm, L the inductance result's l_mh, Ke the ladder result's ke_mv_per_rev_s, Kt = Ke untested. Speed by the ripple tach, stage 2 speed-torque's order tracking (6 events per rev, band-pass +/- 25 %, five passes, the current's integral before the tenth crossing), its rough speed the EMF u - R i - L di/dt over Ke scaled to the pot's slope over 15 to 45 ms; the pot seeds only. Acceleration a_d from a quadratic of the counted angle over +/- 5 ms every 0.5 ms; fits kept when the angle residual is under twice the run's median and no turn window inside them is flagged (local quadratic at 5 %, cross-run median at 6 %). Coast a_c(w) from a quadratic of the bridged coast EMF over +/- 5 ms, interpolated on speed per run-up. j_kg_m2: J of the rotor plus the reflected train, J (a_d - a_c(w)) = Kt i through the origin, the mean over 24 run-ups; lo the concave form i (1 - k i) per run-up mean, hi the line with an intercept per run-up mean; the bounds are the method's ambiguity between three forms that fit to the same residual, not noise. j_origin_kg_m2 the same +/- se; *_by_direction and *_by_set mean +/- sd; j_line_* stage 2's line, j_line_extra_drag_a its intercept as a current (negative: the drive carries less drag than the coast), a fit-form property and not a measured drag; j_ratio the median of Kt i / (a_d - a_c) per run-up, +/- se; j_concave_kg_m2 the concave form per run-up, mean +/- sd over the 23 run-ups whose fit converged (runup-open-1 k2 +1 did not); j_concave_k_per_a its k pooled, +/- se; j_pooled_fit_rms_rad_s2 the three pooled forms' rms. j_pooled_coast, j_awake_zero, j_ke_sag, j_type_drag_curve: the line's J under the direction's pooled coast, the awake-zero current, the sag's Ke, and the type's bare drag curve in place of the coast, +/- se, alternatives. j_over_type over mg90-b's j_kg_m2 (j_type_kg_m2, quoted). j_windows the kept fits, lo and hi their first and last center in s. coast_drag_current_ma_by_speed: -J a_c / Kt with j_kg_m2 in 25 rev/s bins per direction, the train's drag as a current, scale tied to J; coast_decel_by_speed_rad_s2 the bins' median a_c +/- sd; coast_stop_ms median and range. measured_rise_63_ms: t0 + tau of a first-order fit through the turn windows, to 63 % of its asymptote, mean +/- sd per direction (the type's was to a measured settled speed); rise_63_of_cut_speed_ms to 63 % of the speed at the cut, model free; rise_tau_ms, rise_fit_rms_rev_s mean +/- sd. no_load_speed_rev_s and no_load_speed_by_direction: the fit's asymptote, EXTRAPOLATED about 10 % past the 52 ms cut, a candidate no-load speed at 5 V; value the mean, lo and hi the +1 and -1 means. speed_at_cut_rev_s the count's last 5 ms; speed_at_cut_coast_e0_rev_s the coast's E0 (line over 1 to 6 ms back to the cut) over Ke; cut_over_no_load the cut over the asymptote. stall_current_a and stall_terminal_v: 0.8 to 1.5 ms, mean +/- sd. stall_torque_n_m: the torque-on-speed line per direction at zero speed, mean with the two directions as bounds; stall_torque_first_ms_n_m Kt (stall current - the coast's drag under 60 rev/s). peak_power_w: the pooled 0.05 mN m bins' median J a_d w, bounds the per-direction peaks; peak_power_per_run_w per run-up +/- sd; peak_power_line_j_w the same under the line's J (x 1.10); peak_power_torque_n_m and peak_power_rev_s the peak's bin. peak_efficiency the bins' median J a_d w / (u i) at the terminals, bounds by direction, peak_efficiency_torque_n_m its bin. Every torque and power scales with J and carries its bracket. key_numbers_by_direction: per direction the line's stall and zero-torque ends (w0 extrapolated past the counted part), the peaks of power and efficiency, the cut and the asymptote, report only. curve: the pooled bins with at least 10 fits. terminal_source the line of u on i over the fits, report only. output_side_lossless the stall torque x the gear ratio and the asymptote at the horn, before gear loss, comparison only, the no-load speed extrapolated. speed_count_start_ms and _rev_s the first turn window, mean with range; crossings_total, crossings_repaired (added + removed), windows_flagged (either window flag), fits_flagged (the residual flag's count plus the window flag's), report only. count_over_cut_emf_by_direction: the count's last 5 ms over E0 / Ke, mean +/- sd; the -1 count ends about 2.3 % under (the last row 2.4 %), the -1 tach undercounting the leading reading, moderate. oscnb_count_over_order_count ripple.count_cycles over the order count on the last 10 ms, mean +/- sd. pot_over_count_15_45ms the nominal pot slope over the count, the pot's local gain, a seed only. emf_seed_count_maxdiff_pct the EMF-only seed's count against the pot seed's, worst speed difference past 10 ms per run-up, median and range; one run-up fails at 28.5 %. dropouts_*: tel.dropout_rows (quarter of a running mean) over the drive, its first 2 ms and last 1 ms left out, rows per second +/- Poisson (one row as an empty count's floor); by direction and set, over the last 20 ms, by sitting, by 50 rev/s band of the count's speed (bands over 400 rows); dropouts_plus_sitting6_over_1_sigma the +1 rise from sitting 1 to 6 in Poisson sigma, likely; dropout_rows_per_run the rows per run-up. The settled rate is not measured. x_100pct_mv_by_knot: X = u - R i - L di/dt - Ke w over the kept fits within 12.5 rev/s of each knot, mean +/- sd over the run-ups there (3 or more), the current in the unit; x_100pct_ladder_a and _b the ladder's tables 'A - g V_on' and 'B - g (1-D) V_on' at the knots, quoted. x_cut_e0_mv_by_direction u - R i - E0 over the drive's last 5 ms, Ke-free, mean +/- sd; x_cut_count_mv by the count's speed. x_stall_end_mv X at 0.8 to 1.5 ms with the speed from the current's integral, +/- sd. x_vs_ladder_100_dx_di_ohm the run-up's X less the ladder's 3.7 V 100 % rung's at matched speed over the current difference, X's growth with current at one speed, high confidence that X is not a speed table alone; not a series resistance (the stall end reads 67 mV). Readings alive: a brush drop set by speed and current (leading, low to moderate), an EMF falling with current (low), the -1 tach and a running R (partial). The 100 % data does not choose between the ladder's tables A and B. awake_zero_step_counts the coast's last 100 ms over the rest zero, mean +/- sd; crest_less_coast_zero_minus_stage1_ma that zero less stage 1's in-drive offset as a current, the 100 % check of the inductance result's reading term (absent at 100 % to 0.5 mA). x_speed_table_fit_rms_mv the rms of X = c0 + c_dir + c_w w over the fits and the stall ends, report only. rows_missing, rows_dropped, current_raw_max, spin_ms, rail_v (median, range), board_ntc_c_by_sitting: the capture's checks and conditions, report only. ke_used, r_used, l_used, j_type: quoted.
